object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make the second file write fail while deleting an attribute set on an object, and while removing an option in use. Force-delete PARENT-1, which CHILD-0 links to, with the write of PARENT's manifest failing. Force-delete an object with a figure while removing the figure fails. Inside a larger step, let one operation fail after another succeeded. Expected: each failing operation leaves every file of the repository with the bytes it had before it, including CHILD's links file and PARENT-1's object file; in the larger step, only the failed operation is returned and the earlier edit stays.
